name: hitl
description: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) skills for AI agents that need human approval before consequential actions. human-approval-audit: audit an agent's approval gates (LangGraph interrupt, OpenAI needs_approval, ADK, Vercel AI, Claude Agent SDK, MCP elicitation, n8n, Slack/email buttons, custom webhooks) and report what the approval proves: the action, a click, or nothing. human-approval-gate: add an approval step that proves the action, then verify it with the audit.
